text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Dedicated-reserved GPU pool 'resv-west-2a' hitting 100% reserved utilization for enterprise tenant NovaRetail. Queue growth 18x in 10m. Autoscaler reported 429s from cloud API when trying to request new nodes. Link: https://console.redwood.io/metrics/resv-west-2a (severity: high)

alice (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing logs and timeline. Assigning incident lead.

jordan (eng-sre): I see the spike — background batch jobs from NovaRetail are creating long lived sessions, KV cache not being reused. QPS to model endpoints up 12x.

mira (eng-runtime): Autoscaler health shows max_nodes=50, current=50, scale_attempts=8, last_error="rateLimitExceeded". There's a pending queue of ~420 requests (p95 enqueue latency 2.1s -> now 12s).

sam (infra): Cloud provider rate limits are hitting us; requests to create nodes are getting 429s with Retry-After 30s. We're at our account scale ceiling for that region.

alice (oncall): Incident lead: alice (oncall). Objective: triage customer impact, reduce queue growth quickly, and establish short-term mitigations. I need volunteers for mitigation + customer comms.

jordan (eng-sre): I'll take live mitigation: coordinate throttle, preempt best-effort, and investigate eviction.

mira (eng-runtime): I'll patch runtime to enable emergency-per-tenant throttles and evict idle sessions for NovaRetail. Pushing a config change to prod canary first.

cindy (cs): I'll notify NovaRetail CSM and provide ETA once we have mitigation plan. Evan you can be bridge to customer if needed.

evan (customer-success): On standby. Please tag me once we have temporary limits so I can ask them to pause non-critical batch jobs.

jordan (eng-sre): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Apply per-tenant soft throttle to NovaRetail (target reduce tail by 60%) 2) Preempt best-effort reserved sessions older than 2h 3) Force scale down of non-critical pools and reassign spot capacity 4) Fallback routing for latency-sensitive calls to hosted fallback models.

mira (eng-runtime): Preparing config snippet for throttle:
```
routes: 
  nova-retail: 
    concurrency_limit: 40
    token_rate_limit: 120/s
    eviction_policy: idle>2h
```
I'll roll this to 10% canary now.

alice (oncall): Do it. Jordan, coordinate with infra for immediate preemptions.

sam (infra): Kickstarting preemption: evicting best-effort sessions on resv-west-2a across nodes n-045, n-046, n-051. Running command: `./ctl preempt --pool resv-west-2a --selector "job_type=best_effort" --age 2h`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by mira: runtime-config-change v2026.03.15-emt-throttle -> canary (10%).

jordan (eng-sre): Preemption completed on 6 nodes. Freed ~8 GPUs of reserved capacity. Queue dropped from 420 -> 280 in 90s. Still high but improving.

mira (eng-runtime): Canary looks good. No error spikes. Rolling to 50%.

alice (oncall): Sam, any luck getting additional quota from cloud provider?

sam (infra): Opened emergency support ticket. Cloud account team responding - quoted 2-3 hour SLA for quota bump but could be faster. Meanwhile, I can attempt to reassign spot pools from low-priority regions; starting migration orchestration.

jordan (eng-sre): Meanwhile, enabling hosted-fallback for NovaRetail latency-sensitive routes. This will redirect non-reserved calls to hosted infra and mark them as degraded but served. Rolling config now.

mira (eng-runtime): Fallback in place for route `nova-retail/interactive`. We'll mark requests with header X-Redwood-Fallback: hosted.

alice (oncall): Good. What's customer impact now?

cindy (cs): NovaRetail reported slower responses for internal batches, but no outright failures yet. They're aware and paused some non-critical pipelines. I'll update them with mitigation steps.

jordan (eng-sre): Latest metrics: reserved utilization 95%, queue 130, p95 latency for interactive route 680ms (was 220ms). Hosted fallback serving ~18% of interactive traffic. No 500s observed.

alice (oncall): Triage: priority is to avoid evictions of critical reserved sessions and maintain SLAs for interactive endpoints. Secondary: restore autoscaler ability to request nodes.

sam (infra): Cloud responded: temporary quota increase approved for 10 nodes. Provisioning now. Expect nodes ready in ~4m if no further rate limits.

jordan (eng-sre): In parallel I'm adjusting autoscaler backoff thresholds to avoid hammering provider during quota bump. Patch applied.

mira (eng-runtime): Rolling the eviction window back to 3h to protect longer lived critical sessions after initial relief.

deploy-bot: Infra change applied by sam: quota-request-3579 -> accepted -> provisioning.

jordan (eng-sre): New nodes joined the cluster. Reserved pool capacity +10 GPUs. Utilization now 82%. Queue down to 22. p95 latency back to ~230ms.

alice (oncall): Nice work team. Transitioning incident to recovery. Next steps: post-incident RCA, permanent mitigation (rate limiters, autoscaler throttling/backoff, per-tenant batch scheduling), and customer follow-up.

cindy (cs): I'll send a brief to NovaRetail summarizing actions and next steps.

ejan (typo-bot) : (note: ignore)

evan (customer-success): NovaRetail thanks the team; requests a follow-up meeting to discuss batch job best practices.

jordan (eng-sre): Action items:
- jordan: collect heap of logs, autoscaler traces, cloud rate-limit responses (due in 2h)
- mira: add emergency per-tenant throttle toggle in Console (due in 6h)
- sam: engage with cloud account team to raise region capacity floor (due in 24h)
- product: evaluate per-tenant batch scheduling feature (coordinated later)

alice (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated at ts 3579001384. We'll file a postmortem and tag NovaRetail. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
